newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed and Solidere held steady on lower turnover on Wednesday on the Beirut Stock Exchange.
The BLOM index rose 0.1 percent to 896.47 and the LISPI index rose 0.1 percent to 81.80.
Banque Audi was steady at $18 on sharply decreased turnover of 19,444 shares compared with 110,400 on Tuesday. A block of 4,000 shares was also traded off the floor at $18, the BSE said.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the other listed bank, rose to $12.75 from $12.625 and turnover rose to 7,000 shares from 392.
Solidere A shares held steady at $10.25, an alltime low, amid heavy turnover of 97,750 shares. Solidere B shares were also unchanged at $10.75 in turnover of 27,850.
Total BSE turnover was 152,044 shares for a value of $1,736,730 against 217,582 shares for a value of $3,095,917 on Tuesday.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais, Eternit and Uniceramic.
